name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-union-256-p.bal
reason: The case asserts a panic when decimal 256.0, held in an Employee|string|decimal union, is cast to byte|Employee. Type casts, numeric literals, local declarations, calls and type definitions are supported; no restriction excludes union-target numeric casts or their out-of-range panic behavior. The record type and union alternatives introduce no excluded construct.
test_design_notes: The @panic marker asserts failure at the cast; successful completion would violate the asserted behavior.
